q: Walk me through September: how much did we sell, what did it cost us to get those sales, and what was left at the end?
answer:
Net sales for September (by order date, P&L basis) were ₹15,74,765. It cost us ₹11,93,322 in ad spend and ₹6,67,740 in product & operating costs (net COGS), leaving a net loss of ₹2,86,297 for the month.

- Sales: Net sales (P&L basis) = ₹15,74,765. This is the revenue after P&L-level adjustments (cancels, returns, RTOs).
- Cost of goods and operations: Net COGS = ₹6,67,740 (product cost, shipping, packaging, payment fees, provisional ops, RTO & exchange costs).
- Cost to acquire those sales: Ad spend (P&L basis) = ₹11,93,322.
- Bottom line: Net profit (order-date, P&L basis) = −₹2,86,297 (a loss), because ad spend plus COGS and other deductions exceeded net sales.

Worth checking: split the ad spend and attributed contribution by ad platform and by product to see which ads or products drove the losses versus the contribution margin.
